nodes.label: Karpathy-style Agent Engineering Principles
nodes.rationale: Inspired by Andrej Karpathy's practical agent design: Think before coding (no silent assumptions), Simplicity First (zero boilerplate, clean core/services split), Surgical Changes (only touch required code), and Goal-Driven Execution (tests first, offline-first feedback loops). The rationale is to minimize abstraction overhead and maximize traceability.

nodes.label: RAG Architecture (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
nodes.rationale: Files in knowledge/ are segmented by markdown headings, embedded via text-embedding-3-small, cached in .rag-cache/embeddings.json to avoid redundant API calls, and injected as system prompt context. Designed offline-first with optional Prisma/pgvector scale-out.

nodes.label: Hinova SGA Auth Endpoint (POST /usuario/autenticar)
nodes.rationale: Two-step auth: static SGA_API_TOKEN authenticates to get token_usuario which does NOT expire — cache at module level, never re-authenticate per request.

nodes.label: LGPD CPF↔Plate Bind Rule (hard gate)
nodes.rationale: Never expose financial data (boleto, Pix, linha digitável) until CPF is verified against the plate via GET /buscar/situacao-financeira-veiculo/{placa}. On mismatch, deny and trigger human_handoff. This is mandatory because the boleto list endpoint carries no plate field — the bind is the only way to satisfy LGPD.

nodes.label: Circuit Breaker (3 failures/60s → open 120s)
nodes.rationale: Circuit breaker thresholds: 3 failures in a 60s window opens the breaker for 120s. Any SGA failure results in a friendly PT-BR message and human_handoff, with technical details logged without full CPF.
